text:
Ada Noor: hey everyone! i'm Ada — starting today in eng-platform. based in PHX, big stargazer and amateur sourdough baker. excited to join 🎉. would love to host a rooftop stargazing + potluck next Friday after 6pm if folks are into it. i can bring a small telescope, a sourdough boule, and hot cocoa. thoughts? @here
Maya Sato: welcome Ada!! :tada: rooftop sounds amazing. count me in — i make a mean shakshuka.
Rafael: hi Ada, welcome — can you do a quick badge setup ping? if you're at HQ swing by people-ops desk and they'll sort you. also +1 for telescope :nerd_face:
Noah: welcome! seconded badge check. also FYI rooftop reservation needs facilities approval — @people-ops any quick way to book?
Iris: Ada, love stargazing. bring pics!
Ramona: hi Ada, i'm your onboarding buddy — i'll DM you the 1:1 schedule and Slack/zoom links. also we usually do a quick RSVP thread in #lunch-plans for potlucks.
Sam: if we get clear skies i can bring a star-chart app on my iPad. if not, i'll bring boardgames as backup :game_die:
Ada Noor: thanks all! @Ramona that'd be great. Facilities, is there a fast path to reserve rooftop 3? :pray:
People-Ops Bot: Hi @Ada, welcome! Please complete your badge request form: https://hr.internal/badges/new — Facilities reviews rooftop requests within 48h.
Oliver: welcome Ada! FYI rooftop events need to wrap by 9pm per building rules; there's a weather backup plan in the 10th floor lounge if clouds win.
Maya Sato: quick poll — react with one emoji: :star: for stargaze, :shallow_pan_of_food: for potluck & food, :game_die: for games backup.
Noah: :star:
Rafael: :shallow_pan_of_food:
Sam: :game_die:
Ada Noor: love the responses — i'll wait for Facilities and post a formal RSVP + sign-up sheet. thanks for the warm welcome, super excited to be here :wave:
